summary: The gate itself is right — input set complete against the Dockerfile, patterns full-match, PB-safe, no escape hatch, tags and context untouched. But it silently kills the version-poller's weekly rebuild of registry:5000/iac: helmCharts.kaniko stamps the poller labels (verified live on iac:latest — rebuild-at 2026-08-19, pipeline 'IaC/IaC Docker Image', no params), and a poller-triggered build carries an empty changeset, so the stage skips, rebuild-at never advances, and after STALE_GRACE the poller stops triggering and reports the image orphaned. DockerImages' params-driven force path is the half of the sibling pattern PA left behind. Resolving it likely needs an operator ruling: the 'no escape hatch' ruling weighed manual forcing, not the poller.
